174.csv::402.source_text:
ほうほう！　なるほどな！
竜の与えし力により生まれた
新たなる技を欲するかッ！
174.csv::402.translated_text: Hoh hoh! I see, I see! You hunger for a new art born of the power the dragon bestowed!
174.csv::402.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::403.source_text:
ぬおおおおお！　おぬしの大剣が
おぬしの筋肉が、強者の高みへと昇りたがっている！
感じるぞ、その熱意をッ！
174.csv::403.translated_text:
Nuooh! Your greatsword, your muscles—they strain to reach the heights of the mighty!
I feel it, that burning zeal!
174.csv::403.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::404.source_text:
このオリバー、その心意気に応じ
共に戦場を駆けておぬしを導こうぞッ！
試練の場に来るがよいッ！
174.csv::404.translated_text: This Oliver heeds your resolve! Together we'll thunder across the battlefield — I'll guide you! Come to the trial grounds!
174.csv::404.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::405.source_text:
試練の場の＜<STG 587>＞だが
<AREA 9>のエリアランクが
十分でなければ入ることすらできんぞ！
おぬしはすでに試されておるのだッ！
174.csv::405.translated_text: 'Tis the trial grounds [<STG 587>], but <AREA 9>'s area rank must suffice — else you cannot even enter! You have already been tested!
174.csv::405.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::406.source_text:
このオリバー、その心意気に応じ
共に戦場を駆けておぬしを導こうぞッ！
試練の場に来るがよいッ！
遠慮することはない、さぁッ！
174.csv::406.translated_text:
This Oliver heeds your spirit — together we'll tear across the battlefield, and I'll guide you!
Come to the trial grounds!
No need for hesitation, come on!
174.csv::406.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::407.source_text:
試練の場の＜<STG 587>＞だが
<AREA 9>のエリアランクが
十分でなければ入ることすらできんぞ！
おぬしはすでに試されておるのだッ！
174.csv::407.translated_text: 'Tis the trial grounds [<STG 587>], but <AREA 9>'s area rank must suffice — else you cannot even enter! You have already been tested!
174.csv::407.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::408.source_text:
おおお、来たかッ！
共に参らん、頂きへと向かう試練の道をッ！
174.csv::408.translated_text: Ho, you've come! Together we'll tread the trial's path to the summit!
174.csv::408.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::409.source_text: さぁさぁ！　叩き潰し、砕き散らして進まんッ！
174.csv::409.translated_text: Come, come! Let's crush 'em flat, shatter 'em apart, and press on!
174.csv::409.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::410.translated_text: Now then, let's fight to the death!!
174.csv::410.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::411.source_text: むむ――歯ごたえ不足ッ！　さらなる敵の元へいざゆかん！
174.csv::411.translated_text: Hmph—lacks bite! Onward to further foes!
174.csv::411.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::412.source_text: 第二の試練！　剛剣を振るうのだッ！
174.csv::412.translated_text: The second trial! Wield the mighty blade!
174.csv::412.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::413.source_text: 次が最後の試練ぞッ！　期待が高まるだろう！
174.csv::413.translated_text: The next trial is the last! Anticipation mounts!
174.csv::413.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::414.source_text: 括目して見よッ！　あやつが最後の試練ッ！
174.csv::414.translated_text: Behold! That one is the final trial!
174.csv::414.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::415.source_text:
うむ、うむうむうむ！！
あの奥義を使うにふさわしき眼光よ！
よしッ！　我が逗留先に戻り
新たなる戦技を継承しようではないか！
174.csv::415.translated_text: Hah, hah hah hah!! A gaze worthy of that ultimate art! Right then! Back to my quarters — let us pass on a new combat skill!
174.csv::415.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::416.source_text:
うむ、うむうむうむ！！
あの奥義を使うにふさわしき眼光よ！
このオリバーが認めし剣士の業を感じるわッ！
174.csv::416.translated_text:
Hah, hah hah hah!!
That gaze, fit to wield that mystery!
This Oliver senses the swordsman's craft he has acknowledged!
174.csv::416.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::417.source_text:
よしッ！　我が逗留先に戻り
新たなる戦技を継承しようではないか！
174.csv::417.translated_text: Right then! Let us return to my lodgings and pass on a new combat skill!
174.csv::417.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::418.source_text:
全てを打ち砕く力の豪流たるウォリアーの剣
この戦技でさらに冴え渡ろう！
継承するがよいッ！
真の強者への覇道を邁進するのだッ！
174.csv::418.translated_text:
The Warrior's blade—a torrent of power that shatters all!
This combat skill shall whet its edge keener still!
Take this inheritance!
Press onward down the path of supremacy to true might!
174.csv::418.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::419.source_text: フハハハハッ！　戦場を駆けるこの喜びッ！
174.csv::419.translated_text: Fuhahahaha! The joy of racing across the battlefield!
174.csv::419.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::420.source_text: 剣士に盾など不要！　痛みも闘志の糧とするのだッ！
174.csv::420.translated_text: Shields are naught to a swordsman! Pain itself feeds the fighting spirit!
174.csv::420.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::421.source_text: 最強の強者を目指し、死合う！　これぞ本分！
174.csv::421.translated_text: To strive for the mightiest of the mighty, we do mortal battle! 'Tis our true calling!
174.csv::421.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::422.source_text: おぬし、よい顔をしているぞッ！
174.csv::422.translated_text: You've a fine face on you!
174.csv::422.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::423.source_text: ウォリアーなれば、目の前の敵にぶつかり叩き潰すが本懐！
174.csv::423.translated_text: A Warrior's true calling is to crash into the foe afore you and crush them flat!
174.csv::423.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::424.source_text: 敵の攻撃タイミングを見極めッ！　身構えろッ！
174.csv::424.translated_text: Read the foe's strike timing! Brace yourself!
174.csv::424.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::425.source_text: 食らいつき、薙ぎ払い、打ち砕くッ！
174.csv::425.translated_text: Sink your teeth in, mow them down, shatter them!
174.csv::425.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::426.source_text: 痛いか！？　その怒りを大剣に込めて振り下ろすのだッ！
174.csv::426.translated_text: Does it hurt!? Channel that rage into your Greatsword and bring it down!
174.csv::426.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::427.source_text: 振りかぶり、叩き下ろせッ！
174.csv::427.speaker: Oliver

174.csv::428.source_text: 受けた痛みは倍返しだッ！　敵を叩き潰せッ！！
174.csv::428.translated_text: Pain taken is repaid twofold! Crush the foe!!
174.csv::428.speaker: Oliver
